title: ARIRANG World Tour Closes Two-Night Baltimore Stand at M&T Bank Stadium
detail: August 11, 2026 — BTS closes its two-night Baltimore run at M&T Bank Stadium with a second sold-out show, a night after a tornado warning and severe thunderstorms forced fans to shelter inside the stadium and delayed gate openings. The Baltimore Sun and Fox Baltimore report the shows drew ARMY from as far as Mexico, Florida, and Ohio, giving Charm City businesses a significant tourism boost, with city officials hoping to convert first-time visitors into repeat tourists. A Clutchpoints review of the run likened the atmosphere to Beatlemania and the 1964 British Invasion. The Baltimore stand precedes upcoming shows at AT&T Stadium in Arlington (Aug 15-16) and Rogers Stadium in Toronto (Aug 22-23).

media.caption: BTS fans travel from Mexico, Florida, and Ohio for Baltimore's two sold-out M&T Bank Stadium shows, boosting local business.
